arms.A15: new file brute/scalesearch15.py: A14 (brute/scalesearch14, frozen) logic, stop rule, K = 128, 240 s case budget and 9.0 s query cap, with one declared change to the per-size CNF: the trace first-visit symmetry clauses are replaced by (i) apartness clauses x[t] != x[u] for every pair of trace positions t < u that are apart on the trace (a common action continuation after which the observed masks are disjoint; Exact: such positions cannot share a state in any consistent deterministic machine) and (ii) fixed colours for a greedy clique of pairwise-apart positions that contains position 0, x[c_i] = i (symmetry breaking in the style of Heule and Verwer 2010; position 0 keeps state 0, so the start-mode rival check is unchanged). The clique is computed once per pool from the trace at pool creation; apartness only grows as the trace grows, so new apartness clauses are added incrementally. The size search starts at max(A14's lower bound, clique size)
arms.A15_cube: A15 plus a per-size cube split: when a size-n query (least or rival) returns capped, it is re-solved as at most n cubes, one per state q, under the added assumption x[t*][q], where t* is the first trace position outside the clique; each cube is a separate capped call (9.0 s); verdict SAT if any cube is SAT (its model used), UNSAT if every cube is UNSAT, unknown otherwise; bounded by the 240 s case deadline
arms.A14: frozen brute/scalesearch14.active14 (v0.36.0), unchanged, K 128, 240 s; the comparator
